body.label: Effect
body.html: Send an elemental surge through a 3-unit line within 5 units. On a success, deal 1 Lightning damage and move the creature 1 unit.

surges.html: Increase this Action's range by 2 units. If you fully manifest through it, the manifestation also gains +1 Defense until your next turn.
Choose one creature damaged by this Action; apply Shocked. If another creature damaged by this Action is adjacent to it, you may also apply Shocked to that creature.

rider.title: ELEMENTAL — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 5 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 3 additional Mana to fully manifest your Elemental.
